title: The Truth About Graphify's 70x Token Saving Claim
description:

--

The creator of Graphify (500K+ downloads, 43K+ GitHub stars in under a month) sat down with me to break down the plugin everyone in Claude Code is talking about. Is the 70x token savings real? Who is this actually for? And what's coming next?

Safi Shamsi is an AI engineer with two research papers on graph neural networks and hybrid RAG systems. He built Graphify in two days after Andrej Karpathy tweeted about token-efficient memory. Then it exploded.

In this interview we go deep on:
→ The actual ROI for business owners and agencies (and why it's circumstantial, not 70x for everyone)
→ How AST extraction works for free vs when you actually need an LLM
→ The "God nodes" trick — why prompting the graph beats prompting the LLM
→ Local SLMs (Llama backend) vs cloud LLMs — the cost play
→ How to set Graphify up without burning your daily Claude limit
→ Where AI memory is actually heading (neuro-symbolic AI, hyperbolic embeddings, Poincaré ball theory)
→ Why Obsidian alone won't get you the same result
→ What's shipping next: Slack, Google Workspace, OneNote connectors, self-learning brain layer

If you're using Claude Code daily and feeling the context-window pain, this is the breakdown.

📚 RESOURCES MENTIONED
The Memory Layer (Safi's book on graph theory + AI memory):
https://safishamsi.gumroad.com/l/qetvlo
Graphify GitHub repo:
https://github.com/safishamsi/graphify
My original Graphify breakdown video (watch this first if you haven't):
https://youtu.be/EKbQ5sajVxA?si=dgCyoNC_XBBZJPBC
